slides.title: "I am having 2 years experience"
slides.body: Say: "I have 2 years of experience." Have = own, no -ing.

slides.title: "I did my graduation from"
slides.body: Say: "I graduated from..." or "I completed my degree at..."

slides.title: "Myself Rahul"
slides.body: Say: "I'm Rahul" or "My name is Rahul." 'Myself' never starts a sentence.

slides.title: "Revert back"
slides.body: Say: "reply" or "get back to you". Revert already means go back.
